crafts.name: VectorCraft
crafts.topic: vector illustration logo paths pen bezier artboard shapes svg
crafts.guide: Start with an artboard and simple shapes. Use the Pen and Direct Selection tools for editable paths; organise related objects in layers. Keep an editable project before exporting a delivery copy.
crafts.export: Check the artboard bounds and document size, then use the available export command. SVG is useful for editable vector exchange. Inspect fonts, masks and effects in the exported result.
crafts.example: Make a starter logo for my bakery

crafts.name: PhotoCraft
crafts.topic: photo image retouch layers masks raster photoshop filter
crafts.guide: Open a copy of your image. Work on separate layers and use masks rather than permanently erasing pixels. Adjust the composition first, then colour and detail. Save an editable project before flattening.
crafts.export: Keep a layered project and export a separate delivery image. Check dimensions, transparency and colour appearance in the output. Format availability depends on this browser build.
crafts.example: Make an editing checklist for a portrait

crafts.name: FilmCraft
crafts.topic: video movie timeline clips trim cut subtitle captions srt premiere
crafts.guide: Import footage, arrange clips on a timeline and trim the sequence. Balance dialogue before adding music. Review titles and captions, then preview the full sequence before exporting.
crafts.export: Review sequence dimensions, frame rate, audio levels and export settings. Browser builds can have codec or hardware limitations; test a short export before a large job.
crafts.example: Make starter subtitles for a short video

crafts.name: LightCraft
crafts.topic: raw photography exposure white balance highlights shadows lightroom grading
crafts.guide: Begin with white balance and exposure, then recover highlights and shadows carefully. Refine the tone curve and colour. Use local masks sparingly and compare with the original before sharpening.
crafts.export: Keep your original image and non-destructive project. Check crop, output dimensions and colour appearance when exporting. Test one image before processing a series.
crafts.example: Make a RAW photo editing checklist

crafts.name: PdfCraft
crafts.topic: pdf pages annotate annotation reader redact document merge
crafts.guide: Open a copy of the PDF and inspect page order and orientation. Add the required annotations or edits, save a new copy and reopen it to verify the result. Never treat a black rectangle as secure redaction.
crafts.export: Save a separate PDF and reopen it. Verify page count, selectable text, annotations and links. For confidential documents, verify actual redaction removes underlying content.

crafts.name: DesignCraft
crafts.topic: page layout magazine print publishing bleed indesign typography
crafts.guide: Define page size, margins and a consistent grid. Place text and images, apply repeatable styles and check overset text. Review image resolution and print requirements with the printer.
crafts.export: Keep the editable project. Check page size, bleed, fonts and images before PDF export. Confirm the required PDF standard with your printer and inspect the exported pages.

crafts.name: EffectCraft
crafts.topic: motion animation compositing keyframe composition effects lottie
crafts.guide: Create a composition with the intended duration and dimensions. Add layers and animate one property with keyframes. Preview timing before adding effects and check the final frame.
crafts.export: Check duration, frame rate, dimensions and transparency requirements. Use an available export format and test a short composition first. Generated SVG assets are not native EffectCraft projects.
crafts.example: Make a title graphic for my animation

crafts.name: GridCraft
crafts.topic: spreadsheet cells formula sum average budget csv xlsx excel table
crafts.guide: Put clear headers in the first row and keep one record per row. Enter values consistently, then add formulas and check them against a small manual calculation. Save a workbook before importing unfamiliar data.
crafts.export: Save an XLSX workbook to retain formulas and formatting. CSV contains plain table values and does not retain workbook features. Reopen the exported file and verify totals.

crafts.name: WordCraft
crafts.topic: writing word processor document paragraphs headings docx report letter
crafts.guide: Draft the content first and apply heading styles consistently. Use paragraph spacing instead of repeated blank lines. Check tables and page breaks, then review the document before sharing.
crafts.export: Keep an editable document and use a separate delivery copy. DOCX is the native exchange format; PDF is useful for fixed-layout sharing. Check page breaks and fonts after export.

crafts.name: DeckCraft
crafts.topic: presentation slides powerpoint pptx speaker notes slideshow pitch
crafts.guide: Give each slide one main message. Build a short outline, choose a consistent layout and use readable type. Add speaker notes and rehearse the presentation before sharing.
crafts.export: Keep an editable presentation and inspect the delivery export. Check slide order, fonts, images and notes. This mirror pins an older web build, so upstream features may differ.
crafts.example: Make a five slide presentation outline

crafts.name: CADCraft
crafts.topic: cad drafting drawing dxf dwg dimensions circle rectangle autocad
crafts.guide: Set units and work at the intended scale. Draw simple geometry, organise it into layers and add dimensions. Check key measurements before plotting or exchanging the drawing.
crafts.export: Keep an editable drawing and test DXF exchange with the recipient. Confirm units, dimensions and scale. Inspect plotted PDFs before fabrication; this assistant cannot certify engineering safety.
crafts.example: Make a starter rectangular CAD drawing

crafts.name: SoundCraft
crafts.topic: audio music recording daw sound tracks mix wav eq protools
crafts.guide: Create a session and check sample rate and routing. Import or record tracks, set safe levels and edit before mixing. Balance the mix at modest volume and leave headroom.
crafts.export: Check the session range, sample rate, output format and clipping before bouncing. Listen to the exported file on another player. A generated test tone is not a finished mix.
crafts.example: Make a quiet test tone audio file

crafts.name: FigCraft
crafts.topic: interface ui ux design prototype frames components figma wireframe
crafts.guide: Create frames for your target screen sizes. Establish reusable components and spacing rules before adding detail. Connect the main prototype flow, then check contrast and smaller screens.
crafts.export: Keep the editable design. Export selected frames or assets using an available format, check bounds and scale, and review the result. SVG starters are assets, not full interactive prototypes.
